ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem

We need owners, Jira links, and acceptance criteria for the KV cache eviction recurrence. Please keep replies short and name owners.

raj: I can own the investigation and tenant heatmaps. Will open ticket and attach traces.

jira-bot: Created RW-3901: "Investigate KV eviction storm & tenant heatmap" assigned to raj, due 2026-04-10. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3901

matt: I'll take the short-term config tweak + canary and write the runbook.

jira-bot: Created RW-3902: "Short-term eviction threshold tweak + canary" assigned to matt, due 2026-03-30. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3902

kim: I'll own dashboards/alerts and oncall runbook updates (RW-3903).

jira-bot: Created RW-3903: "Dashboards & alerts for cache eviction" assigned to kim, due 2026-03-31. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3903

sophie: I'll add an Optimize probe and regression tests to catch future regressions (RW-3904).

jira-bot: Created RW-3904: "Optimize probe: eviction anomaly detector + regression tests" assigned to sophie, due 2026-04-20. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3904

olivia-pm: I'll be I for coordination and will evaluate the nightly batch windows that coincide with the spikes.

ana: (typo) ana: Proposed RACI: R=Raj, A=Ana, C=Eng-SRE (Matt/Kim), S=Sophie, I=Olivia. Anyone object?

matt: ACK. Canary planned for 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Will ping @oncall-bot for scheduling.

oncall-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z; alert window 30m.

ana: Please add ACs to each ticket. Example ACs: eviction spikes <= 2/min at 2x baseline traffic; p95 latency delta < 5%; no increase in error rate.

raj: Adding ACs and linking playbook + tenant maps to RW-3901 now.

matt: I'll post canary results here and update RW-3902 with runbook and outcome.

ana: Final ask: tag these tickets and the postmortem with label "recurring-incidents" and add a monthly recurring check to the postmortem board. Sophie will own quarterly evals.

sophie: Will add quarterly eval and tag.

ana: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after canary and initial investigation notes are in the tickets.
